_comment: KYV PWA manifest icon entries (Mobile surface). Reversed colorway: cream KYV acronym monogram on solid KYV Green #2F6B4F. Paths are relative to /public; adjust the base path when wiring into the web app manifest. 'any' icons are full-bleed and safe for standard launcher/home-screen use; 'maskable' icons keep the monogram inside the 80% safe circle for adaptive masks.
